description: This file defines the TimesheetService class, which manages operations related to timesheets in the Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating timesheets, and managing related data such as timesheet items, states, and allowed workflows.

classes.name: TimesheetService
classes.description: Service class providing core functionalities for managing timesheets such as retrieval, creation, updating, and workflow management within the HRM system.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of AccessFlowStateMachineService.

methods.name: getTimesheetDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of TimesheetDao.

methods.name: getTimesheetPeriodService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of TimesheetPeriodService.

methods.name: getDetailedTimesheet
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific timesheet by its ID.

methods.name: getTimesheetData
methods.description: Compiles and returns structured data (rows and columns) for a given timesheet.

methods.name: createTimesheetByDate
methods.description: Creates a new timesheet for the specified date, initializing its state and date range.

methods.name: extractStartDateAndEndDateFromDate
methods.description: Calculates the start and end dates of the week containing the provided date, based on configuration.

methods.name: hasTimesheetForDate
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet exists for a particular employee on a specific date.

methods.name: createTimesheetItemsFromRows
methods.description: Converts an array of row data into a collection of TimesheetItem objects.

methods.name: generateTimesheetItemKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key string for a timesheet item based on its identifiers and date.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTimesheetItemsFromRows
methods.description: Creates or updates timesheet items in the database based on provided row data.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowsForTimesheet
methods.description: Determines and returns permissible workflow actions for a given timesheet and user context.
